sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. The leaders arrive in excellent form with five consecutive wins and a draw in their last six outings. Alsager Town, by contrast, sit bottom of the division with just 4 points and have won only once in their last six games, making this a heavily favoured encounter for the home side.
divisionWide: Second-place Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture with title-race implications; Stafford are just two points behind Sandbach and will be eager to maintain pressure, while Dawley (11th, recent win) will look to upset the form book. AFC Bridgnorth, third and unbeaten in five, host Eccleshall (6th, recent loss) in another upper-table clash. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth on 19 points, visit Wednesfield Community at home in a mid-table contest. Foley Meir (11th, recent win) host Bilston Town (6th, recent win) in an interesting mid-table meeting. Market Drayton Town (10th, recent loss) face a tough away trip to New Mills (8th, recent losses), while Shawbury United (15th, poor form with four consecutive losses before a recent win) host Barnton (7th, recent win). Crewe (16th, recent losses) visit Allscott Heath (11th, recent wins) in a lower-half encounter. Cheadle Heath Nomads (17th, recent draws) travel to Telford Town (18th, recent losses) in a battle of struggling sides. Brereton Social (14th, recent win) host Widnes Town (20th, pointless record), a fixture heavily favoured to the home side given Widnes' dire form.
